plays.desc_en: After his first clear, Tian (Maokai) flanks behind Caps (Mel) for a mid gank, forcing Caps to Flash, though Tian also invested resources into the play.
plays.quote: Malakai Can Malakai loop around here ... behind the mail? ... So, Caps had to burn his flash off of

plays.desc_en: Meanwhile bot, Labrov (Rell) chases JackeyLove (Ziggs), adding damage with W and Shattering Strike to secure the kill.
plays.quote: LeBrove ... looking to chase down JackeyLove. ... strike and another kill coming through.

plays.desc_ko: BrokenBlade가 탑 웨이브를 프리징했거나 프리징을 시도해 ZUIAN이 계속 어려운 라인전을 하도록 만듦.

plays.desc_ko: 레벨 6 무렵 JackeyLove가 다시 붙잡혀 Hans Sama가 많은 피해를 넣었으나 아직 킬까지는 부족.
plays.desc_en: Around level 6, JackeyLove (Ziggs) gets caught again and Hans Sama (Sivir) deals heavy damage, though not enough for a kill.
plays.quote: JackeyLove ... once again caught out here. ... Not quite enough damage yet,

plays.quote: Caps nice initial root, level six there ... just be a positive trade in terms of HP.

plays.desc_ko: SkewMond가 정글 캠프를 정리하고 다시 탑에서 바텀 방향으로 이동.
plays.desc_en: SkewMond (Poppy) clears his camps and paths from top toward bot again.
plays.quote: Skewmond on the clear, right back down, ... top to bottom again.

plays.desc_en: G2 catches the flashless fengyue (Pantheon) after the dive, but SkewMond (Poppy) can't find a wall stun angle and both sides back off.
plays.quote: Can he get out now, Fung? ... Strike, lockdown. No flash still. Skumon ... can't quite get the angle to knock him

plays.desc_en: SkewMond (Poppy) starts on the voidgrubs, which casters expected to go uncontested.
plays.quote: Start up. ... The grubs there. ... For Skumond, he should be uncontested.

plays.desc_ko: G2가 미드 포탑도 추가 확보한 상태로 서술되며 TES는 외곽 포탑을 모두 잃음.

plays.quote: And in mid lane, they've got the extra ... tower. So much more safety for G2. ... With TES losing all of their outers, it

plays.quote: All right. Cream going top side, and ... it's a Pantheon trail, but Pantheon ... Trying to do the escort.

plays.desc_ko: 다음 드래곤 교전 45초 전, Tian이 묘목(saplings)으로 시야를 확보하려 함.

plays.desc_ko: TES가 드래곤 경합을 포기하고 물러나는 중 Cream이 붙잡혀 궁극기를 강제로 쓰고 Q를 쌓을 미니언 없이 후퇴에 성공.

plays.desc_en: ZUIAN (Ornn) ults and Teleports while Creme ults over a wall onto Hans Sama, who Spell Shields and Flashes out at about 20 HP; Caps Rebuttals Ornn's ult and melts the shielded Creme, leaving both sides bloodied.
plays.quote: Alfie on Hansama, immediate TP. Cream ... can't quite finish him, but he's got no ... massive, but Caps manages to burn him

plays.desc_ko: 바론 근처에서 이어진 난전. Caps의 솔라 스네어, ZUIAN은 단단했지만 BrokenBlade가 알에서 돌아와 JackeyLove를 묶음(JackeyLove는 Labrov 처치). 두 AP 캐리가 오른을 쓰러뜨리고 SkewMond가 JackeyLove 처치. G2가 4킬, Hans Sama는 바론에게 처형됨.
plays.desc_en: Near Baron, BrokenBlade returns from egg to trap JackeyLove after he kills Labrov; the AP carries down Ornn and SkewMond kills JackeyLove for four G2 kills, while Hans Sama is executed by Baron.
plays.quote: Baron ... Both sides brawling. A bit more damage ... lock up JackeyLove has managed to take
